title: Privacy Center
description:
This website uses first-party and third-party cookies.
Some cookies are strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the site and cannot be disabled.
The others,for analytics and marketing,are optional and are only used if you give us your consent.
legalContent: This website uses first-party and third-party cookies to enhance your user experience,analyze traffic,and,in some cases,display personalized advertising.What is a cookie?Cookies are small text files that are stored on your device when you visit a website. They allow us to remember preferences,count visits,or enable essential site functions.
descEssential: Essential for core site functionality like security and accessibility.
descAnalytics: Anonymized data to help us improve our website structure and content.
descMarketing: Used to deliver personalized advertisements based on your interests.
noThirdParty: This website does NOT use third-party cookies or tracking systems;it exclusively employs its own strictly necessary technical cookies to ensure the security,stability,and proper functioning of the site.
